article.title: MATRADE與HKTVmall推馬來西亞商品專區，指定商品滿額減50元
article.title_en: MATRADE and HKTVmall promote Malaysian goods with a HK$50 threshold offer
article.summary: 合作把馬來西亞食品、保健和生活用品集中到香港網購平台的主題專區。
article.summary_en: The Hong Kong marketplace groups Malaysian food, wellness and lifestyle goods in a dedicated pavilion.
highlights: 主辦方稱專區涵蓋部分清真認證商品。
指定商品消費滿港幣350元，可按活動條款減港幣50元。
highlights_en: The organiser says the selection includes some halal-certified items.
Eligible purchases of HK$350 or more can receive HK$50 off under campaign terms.
article.why: 跨境品牌可藉主題陳列介紹產品來源，並觀察不同價格帶能否組成達標購物籃。
article.why_en: Cross-border brands can tell a provenance story and test which price points make viable baskets.
article.next_step: 按食品、保健及生活類別檢查折扣後毛利，追蹤入店、加購及訂單。
article.next_step_en: Check post-discount margin by category and track visits, basket additions and orders.
article.detail: MATRADE香港辦事處與HKTVmall以主題專區集中展示產品，並用滿額優惠鼓勵顧客探索不同類別。優惠限活動指定商品，商戶評估時應先核對成本、供貨與合資格範圍。若參考相同做法，可分開記錄顧客在專區看到的商品、加購的組合和最後購入品項，以了解主題陳列的作用。
article.detail_en: MATRADE’s Hong Kong office and HKTVmall group products in a themed pavilion and use a spending threshold to encourage browsing. The offer applies to selected items. Review costs, supply and eligibility. Track which products visitors see, add and eventually buy to understand the role of the themed display.
